scope: A universal two-point mean score, not a global approximation guarantee.
arithmetic: Exact fmpq inputs and 192-bit enclosing Arb balls
reduction: Both endpoints are protection kinks, or width one; cubic second derivative
continuous_score: On [m_k,m_(k+1)], interpolate lower_G_(k-1) to lower_G_k; use lower_G_0 for k=0. After the final node, extend the attained value lower_G_(N-1) constantly. The maximum with any independently proved tail score is permitted.
